The '''Senate Guards''' were [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. They were charged with the duty of protecting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They shared this task with members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] assigned to the Senate Building called [[Senate Security Officer]]s.

==History==
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF) Senate Guards were [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era assigned the duty of protecting both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They shared jurisdiction of protecting the Senate Building with members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] called [[Senate Security Officer]]s (SSO).<ref name="SenateTowerCodex" />

Several officers were present at a inquiry by the [[Senate Defense Subcommittee]] on the events surrounding the defection of [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="Coruscant">{{TORcite|Coruscant}}</ref>

They were also present at a formal ceremony congratulating the [[Jedi Consular]] known as [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].<ref name="Coruscant" />

Both the CSF senate guards and the Senate Security Officers were eventually replaced by the more formalized, and separate, [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] organization.<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CSF Senate Guards first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
